facts.fact: Law No. 151 of 2020 entered into force in October 2020 and its Executive Regulations carry a one-year transitional period expiring 31 October 2026, per Shura Law Firm.
facts.system: Personal Data Protection Law No. 151 of 2020

facts.fact: Decree No. 816 of 2025 of the Minister of Communications and Information Technology promulgated the Executive Regulations on 1 November 2025, per Shura Law Firm.
The Personal Data Protection Centre exists and opened its electronic portal for licence, permit and accreditation applications in early October 2026, per Shura Law Firm.
The Centre opened its licence and permit application portal in early October 2026 and may exercise full inspection and enforcement powers from 31 October 2026, per Shura Law Firm.
